items.summary: Confirmed and mechanical, but the drifted location sits outside this shard. The meta files are canonical and correct at `[DEEP]`; ideation-index.md:94-95 carries a stale `[PARTIAL]` that a later ratification superseded and never swept. Git chronology settles the direction beyond argument: the index's two `[PARTIAL]` rows were introduced at f71b1d9 (2026-07-18 01:42:56, 'Step 6 complete — cross-cut synthesis'), and eighteen minutes later d093691 (2026-07-18 02:00:59, 'validate shard complete') promoted both files, its own commit body reading 'meta/constraints.md -> [DEEP] (all 6 axes resolved)' and 'meta/competitive-landscape.md -> [DEEP] (17 competitors, moat, partners)'. That same commit edited ideation-index.md (36 lines added) but left the two Meta Documents rows at their pre-promotion value. The stale side is the index restatement; the meta headers are the ratification. No edit made — the fix must be applied by the shard that owns ideation-index.md.
items.canonicalSource: .memory/wiki/specs/ideation/meta/constraints.md:3-4 — '> Status: `[DEEP]` — all constraint categories resolved during `/ideate-validate` 2026-07-18. / > Budget, Timeline, Team, V1 Scope, Compliance, Performance, and Surfaces all confirmed with owner.'  ·  .memory/wiki/specs/ideation/meta/competitive-landscape.md:3 — '> Status: `[DEEP]` — completed `/ideate-validate` 2026-07-18.'  ·  ratified by commit d093691 (2026-07-18), which supersedes the `[PARTIAL]` rows written by f71b1d9 (2026-07-18) at ideation-index.md:94-95.
corroboration: constraints.md is 392 lines with every declared axis authored out — Budget (:156), Timeline (:170), Team (:179), Release Plan (:189), Compliance (:246), Performance (:271), Project Surfaces (:287). Its residual `[PENDING — /create-prd]` markers (:25-29 auth provider, storage, client state, styling, payments) sit under the heading 'Stack Decisions Still Open' (:19), which states outright that these 'remain open and belong to `/create-prd-stack`'. Deferring a stack choice to the stage that owns it is what a finished ideation constraints file looks like — it is not an unfinished ideation document.

competitive-landscape.md carries all four sections the promotion commit claims — 17 competitors (:26), Unique Differentiators (:67), Moat (:80), Integration Partners vs Competitors (:91). Its Open Questions table (:98-105) follows the tree's convention exactly: every row has an Owner and a Deferred To target, and the closed row Q-02 carries its resolution in the last column ('resolved'). Tracked forward-deferred questions are compatible with `[DEEP]`; they are not evidence of `[PARTIAL]`.

The remaining four rows of the index's Meta Documents table agree with their files' own headers (:91 Problem Statement, :92 Personas, :93 Counterparty Profiles, :96 Cross-Cut Emergent Capabilities, all `[DEEP]`), so the two `[PARTIAL]` rows are an unswept residue, not a table-wide convention the auditor misread.

The drift has exactly one location. Grepping the whole spec tree for status restatements of these two files returns nothing outside ideation-index.md, and no file inside meta/ restates another meta file's status. Fixing the two index rows closes this finding completely — there is no second copy to chase.
items.noEditRationale: Both sides of this contradiction are single-location. The correct side (the meta headers) is canonical and must not be touched; the incorrect side (ideation-index.md) belongs to another agent's shard. Adding a defensive note to the meta files saying 'the index is wrong about us' would edit the canonical source to work around a stale restatement — that inverts the fix and leaves the wrong value live where downstream stages actually read it.
